import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { RideService } from '../../../core/services/ride.service'; import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-history', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], template: `

Historique des courses

{{ ride.date }} {{ ride.price }} TND
{{ ride.origin }}
{{ ride.destination }}
Chauffeur : {{ ride.driver }} Terminée
` }) export class HistoryComponent implements OnInit { rides = [ { date: 'Aujourd’hui à 11:20', origin: 'El Menzah', destination: 'Centre Ville', price: 6.5, driver: 'Mohamed Ben Ali' }, { date: 'Hier à 18:45', origin: 'La Marsa', destination: 'Lac 2', price: 9.0, driver: 'Sami Khemir' }, { date: '04 Nov à 08:30', origin: 'Bardo', destination: 'Avenue Habib Bourguiba', price: 5.0, driver: 'Amine Jlassi' } ]; constructor(private rideService: RideService, private authService: AuthService) {} ngOnInit(): void {} }
